tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Shows the plan, the solves left today, the balance and the time until the daily reset. Free to call.

tools.name: report_result
tools.description: Tells Solvecha whether a reCAPTCHA answer was accepted or rejected. Free, optional, and it improves accuracy.

tools.name: solve_funcaptcha
tools.description: Solves a FunCAPTCHA tile-selection puzzle (mode 'tile') or a game-style match puzzle (mode 'match') and returns which tiles to pick. Costs one credit per successful solve.

tools.name: solve_geetest_slider
tools.description: Solves a GeeTest slider puzzle and returns how far to drag the handle, as a percentage of the background width. Costs one credit per successful solve.

tools.name: solve_recaptcha_grid
tools.description: Solves a Google reCAPTCHA v2 image challenge from a screenshot and returns which tiles to click. Send the instruction text (task), the layout (grid) and the picture(s). Waits for the answer (usually 2 to 6 seconds). Costs one credit per successful solve. After you click and submit, call report_resul

tools.name: solve_text_captcha
tools.description: Reads a picture with distorted letters and digits and returns the text (case-sensitive). Costs one credit per successful solve.
